grh_1682d369600e3403054f.title: Work of Art
paragraphs: In wartime Buenos Aires, Harry becomes interested in an art collection belonging to a woman connected with a wealthy Nazi munitions manufacturer and decides to steal a supposed Rubens. He slips back into her gallery after a dinner party and escapes with the painting, only to learn from a fence that it is merely a well-made copy worth about $100. Harry realizes he has been used in an insurance scheme: the fake was insured as an original, and his theft gives its owner a convincing loss while leaving him exposed as the burglar. A sympathetic contact buys the worthless copy and helps Harry leave the country. Harry later learns that the deception also helped preserve the woman's reputation while she secured a divorce and a new marriage.

grh_16b3b0f12509410444b4.title: Between Office Hours
paragraphs: Bruiser Burns, a wrestler and convicted killer being taken for psychiatric observation, badly crushes three fingers in a car door. Dr. Christian has no choice but to amputate the mangled fingers to save the arm. Months later Burns is judged criminally insane and escapes while being transferred from the asylum, convinced that Christian deliberately ruined his fighting career. He tracks the doctor to his office during the supposedly quiet gap between office hours and holds Judy while waiting to kill them both. Christian wakes from a nap, realizes the escaped man is inside, darkens the office and helps trip and overpower him. Even after Burns has tried to murder him, Christian notices something lodged in the man's inflamed eye and calmly removes it before the police arrive.
